newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei ends down for fifth session.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei ends down for fifth session.

text.p: The Tokyo Nikkei average fell for the fifth successive day on Friday as investor sentiment was bogged down by uncertainties over a new coalition government as well as the state of the economy, brokers said.

"There were fervent hopes for a rebound in the Nikkei average but the index showed no signs of regaining its feet," said Harushige Kobayashi, deputy general manager at Yamaichi Securities. "Investors were really reluctant to buy ahead of the weekend, especially with the new government still shaky."
The key benchmark of 225 selected issues shed 263.52 points or 1.25 percent to end at 20,739.97, closing below the 21,000 threshold for the first time in two weeks.
Its December futures ended down 320 points at 20,770.
